frame: Viewed from shower; NE upper-right stud, SW lower-left stud, U upper control tip, L lower control tip. The user confirms straight-line 3D distances from the center of one projecting end face to the center of another, at their differing Z depths. These are not distances projected onto the tile plane. Exact jaw-contact procedure and repeatability remain unspecified.

user_reconciliation_preference.quote: assume my calipers are more correct as a whole, but can do some smoothing with reference to our lidar scan if that makes sense.
user_reconciliation_preference.interpretation: Fit the joint geometry primarily to the caliper readings; use only the installed wall/valve Polycam scan as weaker corroboration and orientation/depth guidance. Preserve raw readings and scan. Never silently replace observations or average unrelated pair errors. Show weights, residuals and sensitivity. Do not assign statistical accuracy from caliper digits or fit residuals.

application_status: Raw 3D lengths and their endpoint definition are retained in revision 2 of this supplemental study. R005 accepted part dimensions and the original scan transform are unchanged.
